inclusions: Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary.

days.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Madurai and Local Sightseeing
activities: Meet and greet with our representative.
Check in to the hotel and freshen up.
Visit the famous Meenakshi Amman Temple.
Visit Thirupparankundram Murugan Temple, subject to time availability.
Visit Gandhi Memorial Museum, subject to time availability.
In the evening, explore the surroundings of Meenakshi Amman Temple.

days.title: Day 2 – Madurai to Rameswaram
activities: Early morning breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy the scenic journey towards Pamban Island.
Stop for a view of the famous Pamban Bridge.
Arrive in Rameswaram and check in to the hotel.
Proceed for darshan at Ramanathaswamy Temple.
Visit Ramar Padam, subject to time availability.

days.title: Day 3 – Rameswaram Local Sightseeing
activities: Early morning breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy the scenic coastal drive towards Dhanushkodi.
Visit the ruins and beach area of Dhanushkodi.
Visit Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial.
Visit Pamban Bridge viewpoint, if not covered on the previous day.
Evening free for personal activities or optional temple darshan.

days.title: Day 4 – Rameswaram to Kanyakumari
activities: Early morning breakfast at the hotel.
En route, visit Suchindram Thanumalayan Temple, subject to time availability.
Arrive in Kanyakumari and check in to the hotel.
In the evening, witness the famous sunset at Kanyakumari.

days.title: Day 5 – Kanyakumari Sightseeing and Departure
activities: Early morning witness the beautiful sunrise at Kanyakumari.
Proceed to Vivekananda Rock Memorial by ferry, subject to ferry operations and weather conditions.
Visit the nearby sightseeing points, subject to departure timings.
Proceed towards Trivandrum Airport for departure.
